classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design up to two binder candidates against a user-supplied target structure using two parallel BindCraft trajectory shards, evaluate each resulting binder with Boltz-2 affinity prediction and lightweight sequence QC, then aggregate and rank the candidates.
assumptions: target_pdb and target_sequence must be supplied at runtime; they are declared as workflow parameters and listed in missing_inputs.
Two BindCraft shards (seed 1 and seed 2, num_designs 1 each) follow the tool's recommended_shard_size of 1 and stay within the default_max_parallel of 2.
permissive filter mode maximises the probability that each single-trajectory shard yields a passing design.
max_trajectories is capped at 50 per shard to bound GPU time; raise this parameter if hit-rate is low.
binder_length is fixed at 60 residues (tool default); adjust in node inputs if a different length is needed.
Boltz-2 runs without MSA (use_msa: false) for speed; affinity scores are calibrated approximations without MSA depth.
target_chain defaults to A; override params.target_chain for targets with non-standard chain identifiers.
No hotspot residues are specified; BindCraft will sample binding modes across the full target surface — focused hotspots should be added once binding-site information is available.
sequence_analysis runs at physiological pH 7.4 and omits the per-residue table (include_residue_table: false) to keep output compact.
rank_designs aggregates all upstream job objects; top_k is set to 2 to match the two candidate shards.
missing_inputs: target_pdb — absolute path to the target structure PDB file; required by bindcraft (structure input) and indirectly by boltz2_affinity (binder complex geometry).
target_sequence — single-letter amino acid sequence of the target chain; required to construct the boltz2_affinity sequences list for the target+binder complex.

success_criteria.two_designs_produced: design_seed1 and design_seed2 each emit at least one binder_sequence
success_criteria.affinity_scores_present: eval_seed1 and eval_seed2 each return a valid affinity_score from Boltz-2
success_criteria.seq_qc_complete: seq_qc_seed1 and seq_qc_seed2 complete without errors and report charge, composition, and region annotations
success_criteria.ranked_table: rank node returns a ranked table with 1–2 candidates ordered by combined affinity and QC metrics
